# Test fonts

The latin subset of [Fredoka](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Fredoka), as Google Fonts serves it. It is one variable font that covers the 400, 500, 600 and 700 weights the game uses, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. `scripts/og-image.ts` and the browser tests serve it in place of Google Fonts, so they render the real font offline.
